description: Canonical SPDX license record by identifier: full name, OSI/FSF approval status, deprecation flag and reference URL, from the official SPDX license list. $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base); response includes a provenance chain and an Ed25519 attestation.

payment.description: Encoded x402 X-PAYMENT header value. Omit to receive the payment requirements (free quote).

name: spdx_license_lookup
